# GuiExpert Table

> A UI-agnostic, performant table component library supporting Plain JS/TS, Vue3, React, Preact, Solid, Svelte, Web Component, and Angular. Offers large table support with advanced features like virtual scrolling, sorting, filtering, column/row resizing & spanning, accessibility, custom renderers, and state persistence.

## Core Library
- [@guiexpert/table (core)](https://github.com/guiexperttable/mono/tree/main/packages/table): The framework‑agnostic foundation for all table implementations.
- [Plain JS/TS usage](https://github.com/guiexperttable/mono/tree/main/packages/table): Basic integration with JavaScript/TypeScript.

## Framework Adapters
- [Vue 3](https://github.com/guiexperttable/mono/tree/main/packages/vue3-table)
- [React](https://github.com/guiexperttable/mono/tree/main/packages/react-table)
- [Preact](https://github.com/guiexperttable/mono/tree/main/packages/preact-table)
- [Solid](https://github.com/guiexperttable/mono/tree/main/packages/solid-table)
- [Svelte](https://github.com/guiexperttable/mono/tree/main/packages/svelte-table)
- [Web Component](https://github.com/guiexperttable/mono/tree/main/packages/webcomponent-table)
- [Angular Adapter](https://github.com/guiexperttable/mono/tree/main/packages/angular-table): Standalone TableComponent for Angular 14–22.

## Demos & Models
- [Demo Table Models](https://github.com/guiexperttable/mono/tree/main/packages/demo-table-models): Sample data, e.g., crypto-data and order-data types.

## Getting Started & Docs
- [Training: GuiExpert Table step by step](https://gui.expert/training/): 35 short chapters with live demos – from the first table to millions of rows, sorting, filtering, Excel export, editing, live data and accessibility.
- [API reference](https://gui.expert/api/): every class, interface and option, with type-checked examples.
- [README file](https://github.com/guiexperttable/mono/blob/main/README.md): Overview and project structure.
- Choose your stack and import `@guiexpert/table` + appropriate adapter.

## Optional Extras
- 🔧 *.md source versions of key documentation pages* (e.g., README.md) are available in repo.
- 🧑‍💻 *Developer community*: use issues and discussions on GitHub for support and feedback.

## Notes
- Designed for large tables and performance-first use cases.
- Accessible: WAI-ARIA grid/treegrid for screen readers, full keyboard navigation, announcements via a live region, checked with axe-core (WCAG 2.1 AA) – since 1.1.91.
- Overlays "Loading…" (CSS spinner, tableApi.showLoadingOverlay(), `loading` prop in every wrapper) and "No rows to show" / "No matching rows" – plain HTML/CSS, no library – since 1.1.92.
- Row numbers like in a spreadsheet: `rowNumbersVisible: true` in TableFactory.createTableModel (or RowNumberColumnDef) – fixed left, width fits the largest number, click selects the row – since 1.1.93.
- Total rows that follow filter and sorting: `footerAggregates: { total: "sum" }` in TableFactory.createTableModel (sum, count, avg, min, max, countDistinct, first, last or your own aggregator; several rows with labels), helpers aggregate() / aggregateColumns(), and count/sum/average of the selected cells for a status bar (tableApi.getSelectionAggregates()) – since 1.1.94.
- State persistence: column layout, sorting, scroll position, tree, checked and selected rows – in localStorage (autoRestoreOptions) or on your server (tableApi.getState() / applyState(), initialState, onStateChanged) – since 1.1.92.
- Components are framework‑agnostic; core stays consistent across ecosystems.
- Repository is actively maintained as of mid‑2025.
